subject.title: [Bug]: Google vertex is now called Google Enterprise AI

question: What exact user-facing label should OpenClaw use for the existing `google-vertex` provider?
rationale: Source inspection confirms stale visible copy, but the requested wording differs from current Google docs and a broader provider rename would be compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Use docs-aligned Gemini Enterprise wording
options.body: Update labels/docs to `Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)` or a close maintainer-approved variant while keeping `google-vertex` stable.

options.title: Keep Google Vertex AI for now
options.body: Leave the current label until Google API, SDK, and OpenClaw docs intentionally move away from Vertex AI terminology.

options.title: Use Google Enterprise AI
options.body: Match the reporter's suggested wording even though it does not match the official Google Cloud page title found during review.

recommendation.title: Use docs-aligned Gemini Enterprise wording
recommendation.body: Update labels/docs to `Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)` or a close maintainer-approved variant while keeping `google-vertex` stable.

likelyOwner.reason: This login has the strongest code-history and recent provider-onboarding metadata signal for choosing and applying the provider label safely.
